title: Act: Add work root, max budget, auto-publish and provider kind fields with defaults
description: Add four fields to WorkerConfig, default constants, default assignment in LoadFS and example YAML keys.
acceptance_criteria: WorkerConfig has WorkRoot, MaxBudget, AutoPublish, ProviderKind with yaml tags
LoadFS applies defaults for omitted keys

steps.action: Add constants defaultWorkRoot = ".storyforge/work", defaultMaxBudget = 5.0, defaultProviderKind = "mock" inside the existing const block.
steps.expected: Constants compile alongside the existing ones.

steps.code:
WorkRoot     string  `yaml:"work_root"`
MaxBudget    float64 `yaml:"max_budget"`
AutoPublish  bool    `yaml:"auto_publish"`
ProviderKind string  `yaml:"provider_kind"`
steps.expected: yaml keys work_root, max_budget, auto_publish, provider_kind unmarshal into the struct.

steps.action: After the MaxRetries default, set WorkRoot to defaultWorkRoot when empty, MaxBudget to defaultMaxBudget when 0, ProviderKind to defaultProviderKind when empty. AutoPublish stays as parsed (false default).
Append under worker: work_root, max_budget, auto_publish and provider_kind lines.
steps.expected: Example config lists all new keys with defaults.
